purpose: Teach: 配線/一周/進め方/納入/現職/心構え/立ち上がる/取り組ま

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: オフィス、配線、整理しよう。
lines.style: Brisk, efficient opening. Clear directive tone. Straightforward cadence, no hesitation. The voice of someone moving through a checklist with purpose.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。年に一周する点検、欠かさず実施しています。
lines.en: Yes. We conduct that annual inspection without fail.
lines.style: Cooperative and assured. Steady, measured pace. Light emphasis on the thoroughness. Professional but warm—the tone of someone confirming their competence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業務の進め方、改善、急ぐね。
lines.en: We need to speed up our workflow improvements.
lines.style: Direct, slightly urgent undertone. Lean forward in the voice. Purposeful rhythm—not rushed, but focused. The tone of someone setting a clear priority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。部品、納入先、追加しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've added new parts suppliers to our list.
lines.style: Prompt, factual delivery. A light uptick of accomplishment on 'added.' Steady and competent. The voice of someone reporting progress matter-of-factly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.en: We're looking into increasing our current staff.
lines.style: Deliberate, measured tone. Slight weight on the decision-phase nature of this. Professional but open—not dismissive. The voice of someone thinking through logistics out loud.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。心構えを養う研修、来月実施します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll run that mindset-building training next month.
lines.style: Bright, forward-looking energy. Light lift on the opening. Confident pacing. The tone of someone invested in the team's readiness and genuinely optimistic about it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新部署、立ち上がるタイミング、年明けかな。
lines.en: The new department might launch in early spring, I think.
lines.style: Contemplative, provisional. Slight questioning lilt at the end—thinking out loud rather than declaring. Warm but uncertain. The voice of someone working through timing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。複数案件、同時に取り組ませる、避けます。
lines.en: Yes. We'll avoid pushing multiple projects on them at once.
lines.style: Firm, protective undertone. Steady, measured. Quiet conviction on 'avoid.' The tone of someone who has thought about pacing and wants to protect the team from overload.
